items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: because Vi had a lot of pennies, and she put them together and she'd cook a pot of beans

ctx.x: Yeah. We played the Cotton Club. Because I remember we was driving so fast... Zutty had his car, we were going about 90, right close behind each other, you know. Dogs had their heads out the windows.
But things was pretty rough then, too, because Vi had a lot of pennies, and she put them together and she'd cook a pot of beans and shit like that. Heh-heh.
What was the problem with Zutty? Was he temperamental?
